shorts.hook: Antarctica has an icicle that grows down and freezes the seafloor.
shorts.title: This Antarctic Icicle Grows Down and Freezes the Seafloor
shorts.outro: The next trap does not stop one arm short. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: A brinicle of cold brine reaches the Antarctic seabed and freezes a web of ice over every sea star too slow to escape, including Doug in costume.

shorts.hook: When an avalanche stops, the snow can set like concrete.
shorts.title: When an Avalanche Stops, the Snow Sets Almost Like Concrete
shorts.outro: Doug was making a snow angel on that exact slope. The full video is linked below.
shorts.end_card: WHAT HAPPENS TO DOUG? TAP BELOW
shorts.description: Avalanche snow is soft when it hits you, but as the debris stops the grains jam together and bond until it can bury people basically like concrete.

shorts.hook: Nine in ten mammal fossils at La Brea are predators.
shorts.title: La Brea's Mammal Fossils Are Mostly Predators Lured by Bait
shorts.outro: The last two traps never let go at all. The full video is linked below.
shorts.description: Roughly 90 percent of the mammal fossils at the La Brea Tar Pits are predators, because every stuck animal became the bait for the next one, Doug included.
